For Jeremy Wade, the thrill isn't simply catching a fish. It's uncovering the truth behind extraordinary aquatic creatures and tracking down the ones that seem almost impossible to find. From the icy waters of Alaska, where giant Pacific halibut and disappearing king salmon raise questions, to Australia's murky rivers hiding enormous freshwater crayfish and unusual catfish, every expedition brings him closer to his next big discovery.
Watch Jeremy Wade's Dark Waters, Season 1, Episodes 2, 4, 5, 7, 6, 8 and 1, on Animal Planet India.
